dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: We're currently questioning the suspect connected to gray-market gambling operations. We'll keep you all posted as soon as we have any new information.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Sounds like I'm no longer needed here. Guess I'll be on my way...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: As a key witness, you may be called upon to attend the follow-up trial, Mr. Wriothesley.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Sorry, I meant... Could I maybe attend anonymously?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Uh... How exactly would that work? Do you even hear yourself?
